column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 19 (M23019): The Elmo menyerbu untuk mengulur waktu; Mokosh bertahan sampai akhir.
# Tetap Inggris: Groza, Colphne, Mayling, Vasily, Wulfgar, Zhaohui, Faye, Nemesis,
# Krolik, Zucchero Squad, Monsoon Squad, Squad 404, Shell of Amni, The Elmo,
# Mokosh, Mangi Security, Oathguards, Doll, Frame, Neural cloud, Remolding Pattern.
(Just as the morning light fell on the windowsill of The Elmo, a figure hurriedly ran into the treatment room.)
column2: (Tepat saat cahaya pagi jatuh di ambang jendela Elmo, sesosok orang berlari tergesa masuk ke ruang perawatan.)

column1: (However, before the person could speak, the medical Doll by the bed gently shook her head. As if triggered by this action, the figure immediately wilted and uncontrollably let out a low whimper.)
column2: (Namun sebelum orang itu sempat bicara, Doll medis di sisi ranjang menggeleng pelan. Seolah terpicu gerakan itu, sosok tadi langsung lunglai dan tak kuasa menahan isak lirih.)

column1: (Mayling tightly grasped the edge of the bed with both hands, her shoulders shaking in grievance.)
column2: (Mayling mencengkeram tepi ranjang erat-erat dengan kedua tangan, bahunya berguncang menahan sedih.)

column1: (A whole night had passed since Squad 404 escorted the Commander back to the Elmo, yet the Commander was still lying quietly on the sickbed with closed eyes, showing no signs of waking up.)
column2: (Semalam penuh sudah berlalu sejak Squad 404 mengawal Komandan kembali ke Elmo, tapi Komandan masih terbaring diam di ranjang dengan mata terpejam, tanpa tanda-tanda akan sadar.)

column1: (Even though the Commander had temporarily escaped life-threatening danger after treatment, the passing time still made Mayling very uneasy. As if seeing through the girl's worry, Colphne tried hard to suppress the same feelings in her neural cloud and managed to show a smile.)
column2: (Meski Komandan untuk sementara sudah lepas dari bahaya maut setelah dirawat, waktu yang terus berjalan tetap membuat Mayling sangat gelisah. Seolah menembus kecemasan gadis itu, Colphne berusaha keras menekan perasaan yang sama di Neural cloud-nya dan berhasil menyunggingkan senyum.)

column1: It's okay, Mayling, the Commander is recovering. Let the Commander rest for another two days, and everything will definitely be fine.
column2: Tidak apa-apa, Mayling, Komandan sedang pulih. Biarkan Komandan beristirahat dua hari lagi, semuanya pasti baik-baik saja.

column1: But—
column2: Tapi—

column1: (Looking at the girl's two huge dark circles, Colphne got up and approached, unceremoniously pinching her cheek.)
column2: (Melihat kantung mata gadis itu yang menghitam tebal, Colphne bangkit mendekat dan mencubit pipinya tanpa basa-basi.)

column1: Hmm~ Has Mayling been pulling all-nighters fixing Frames again?
column2: Hmm~ Mayling begadang memperbaiki Frame lagi, ya?

column1: If you keep pushing yourself like this, I'm afraid The Elmo's top mechanic might collapse before the Commander even wakes up, you know?
column2: Kalau kau terus memaksakan diri begini, bisa-bisa mekanik nomor satu Elmo tumbang duluan sebelum Komandan sadar, lho?

column1: Ugh... but if I can repair Squad 404 sooner, Mokosh will have one more combat force. Everyone is still fighting hard, I-I can't fall behind either!
column2: Ugh... tapi kalau aku bisa memperbaiki Squad 404 lebih cepat, Mokosh dapat satu kekuatan tempur lagi. Semua orang masih bertempur mati-matian, a-aku juga tidak boleh kalah!

column1: Hehe, if Mayling wants to help everyone, I actually have a better idea.
column2: Hehe, kalau Mayling ingin membantu semua orang, sebenarnya aku punya ide yang lebih bagus.

column1: Captain! Why are you here?
column2: Kapten! Kenapa Anda di sini?

column1: (Groza didn't answer, just walked quickly to the bedside. She gently stroked the Commander's pale and haggard face, then looked up at Colphne.)
column2: (Groza tidak menjawab, hanya melangkah cepat ke sisi ranjang. Dia mengusap lembut wajah Komandan yang pucat dan letih, lalu mendongak menatap Colphne.)

column1: The Commander's awakening time is still uncertain, right?
column2: Waktu Komandan sadar masih belum pasti, kan?

column1: Mhm. And, considering the Commander's health, even if awakened, it is not suitable to continue high-intensity combat command work.
column2: Mhm. Dan mengingat kondisi kesehatan Komandan, sekalipun sadar, dia tidak layak melanjutkan pekerjaan memimpin pertempuran berintensitas tinggi.

column1: Then, we can't wait any longer. In one night, the battle situation in Mokosh has been deteriorating, we must buy them time.
column2: Kalau begitu kita tidak bisa menunggu lagi. Dalam semalam, situasi pertempuran di Mokosh terus memburuk, kita harus mengulur waktu untuk mereka.

column1: What does the Captain mean?
column2: Apa maksud Kapten?

column1: With the Commander absent, we will complete this support operation.
column2: Dengan Komandan tidak ada, kita yang akan menuntaskan operasi bantuan ini.

column1: Mayling, as the mechanic most familiar with The Elmo's engine, I need your help.
column2: Mayling, sebagai mekanik yang paling paham mesin Elmo, aku butuh bantuanmu.

column1: (Twenty minutes later, The Elmo, traveling at full speed, sped all the way, charging straight at Mangi Security's deployed front line.)
column2: (Dua puluh menit kemudian, Elmo melaju kecepatan penuh tanpa henti, menerjang lurus ke garis depan yang digelar Mangi Security.)

column1: (Like a fireball crashing around, and like an incomparably sharp knife, The Elmo used drones to pour out all the bunker busters and heavy munitions captured from Mangi Security, striving to block Mangi Security's advance towards Mokosh.)
column2: (Bagai bola api yang menghantam ke mana-mana, sekaligus bagai pisau yang teramat tajam, Elmo memakai drone untuk menghujankan seluruh bom penembus bunker dan amunisi berat rampasan dari Mangi Security, berjuang menghadang laju Mangi Security ke Mokosh.)

column1: Zucchero Squad, coordinate with The Elmo's route and launch an attack on the enemy's west front! Nemesis, Krolik, assist from the flanks, the goal is to block the remaining enemy forces from advancing towards Mokosh!
column2: Zucchero Squad, selaraskan dengan rute Elmo dan lancarkan serangan ke front barat musuh! Nemesis, Krolik, bantu dari sayap, sasarannya menghadang sisa pasukan musuh yang bergerak ke Mokosh!

column1: Mayling, continue to increase firepower, we need to attract more enemies.
column2: Mayling, terus naikkan daya tembak, kita perlu memancing lebih banyak musuh.

column1: Yup!
column2: Siap!

column1: (Bang! Bang-bang!)
column2: (Dor! Dor-dor!)

column1: (Relying on the huge size of the land battleship and the strong firepower coordinated with the ground, The Elmo quickly attracted the attention of a large number of enemies.)
column2: (Bertumpu pada ukuran raksasa kapal perang darat itu dan daya tembak kuat yang diselaraskan dengan pasukan darat, Elmo cepat menyita perhatian musuh dalam jumlah besar.)

column1: (The troops surging towards Mokosh turned one after another and fought with the two squads; countless sparks bloomed outside The Elmo's windows, shaking the vehicle body and making it rumble.)
column2: (Pasukan yang membanjir ke arah Mokosh satu per satu berbalik dan bertempur dengan kedua regu itu; percikan tak terhitung mekar di luar jendela Elmo, mengguncang bodi kendaraan dan membuatnya bergemuruh.)

column1: Mayling, can the defense system still hold up?
column2: Mayling, sistem pertahanannya masih sanggup?

column1: No problem! At this attack frequency, it can withstand it!
column2: Tidak masalah! Dengan frekuensi serangan segini, masih tahan!

column1: I will.
column2: Baik.

column1: (Amidst the ceaseless roar of artillery, Groza issued another order into the comms channel.)
column2: (Di tengah deru artileri yang tak henti, Groza menurunkan satu perintah lagi ke kanal komunikasi.)

column1: Now we must pin down the enemy as much as possible and draw fire away from Mokosh. The more enemy units the Elmo can tie down, the more advantageous the battle will be for Mokosh.
column2: Sekarang kita harus menahan musuh sebanyak mungkin dan menarik tembakan menjauh dari Mokosh. Makin banyak unit musuh yang bisa diikat Elmo, makin menguntungkan pertempuran ini bagi Mokosh.

column1: To enhance combat capability, everyone may judge for themselves and activate the Remolding Patterns at the appropriate times. Until the Elmo's final alarm sounds, this battle must continue!
column2: Untuk memperkuat kemampuan tempur, kalian boleh menilai sendiri dan mengaktifkan Remolding Pattern pada waktu yang tepat. Sampai sirene terakhir Elmo berbunyi, pertempuran ini harus terus berjalan!

column1: Mr. Vasily, the frontline reports that the enemy forces outside the city seem to be temporarily pinned down, and the speed of their reinforcements is slowing!
column2: Pak Vasily, garis depan melapor pasukan musuh di luar kota sepertinya untuk sementara tertahan, dan laju bala bantuan mereka melambat!

column1: We, we still have a chance—
column2: Ki-Kita masih punya peluang—

column1: (Vasily looked around—in the underground combat base, there were very few spare Doll Frames left; in the combat material warehouse, the remaining ammunition was also about to be exhausted.)
column2: (Vasily menyapu pandangan ke sekeliling—di markas tempur bawah tanah, Frame Doll cadangan tinggal sangat sedikit; di gudang material tempur, sisa amunisinya pun nyaris habis.)

column1: (And on the ground, in the streets, Wulfgar operated the Shell of Amni, and together with the remaining Oathguard squads, was making the final resistance.)
column2: (Dan di permukaan, di jalanan, Wulfgar mengendalikan Shell of Amni, bersama sisa regu Oathguard melancarkan perlawanan terakhir.)

column1: (Even if they temporarily got a breather, Mokosh at this moment was almost unable to continue.)
column2: (Sekalipun sempat mendapat jeda bernapas, Mokosh saat ini nyaris tak sanggup melanjutkan.)

column1: (This defensive battle will most likely end soon—with Mokosh's defeat as the ending.)
column2: (Pertempuran bertahan ini kemungkinan besar akan segera berakhir—dengan kekalahan Mokosh sebagai penutupnya.)

column1: (But as the leader of Mokosh, even seeing that defeat is certain, he will not give up hope and surrender without a fight.)
column2: (Tapi sebagai pemimpin Mokosh, sekalipun melihat kekalahan sudah pasti, dia tidak akan melepas harapan dan menyerah tanpa perlawanan.)

column1: (Vasily sighed deeply, stood up, and patted the technician on the shoulder.)
column2: (Vasily menghela napas dalam, berdiri, dan menepuk bahu teknisi itu.)

column1: You're right, Mokosh has reached the point where we must fight to the very last moment.
column2: Kau benar, Mokosh sudah sampai di titik di mana kita harus bertempur sampai detik terakhir.

column1: Relax, if it really comes to the moment when we need to surrender. I will accept the enemy's disposal in the name of the leader, and at least demand that the enemy spare everyone in Mokosh.
column2: Tenang, kalau memang tiba saatnya kita harus menyerah, aku akan menerima hukuman musuh atas nama pemimpin, dan setidaknya menuntut musuh mengampuni semua orang di Mokosh.

column1: Before that... we haven't lost yet!
column2: Sebelum itu... kita belum kalah!

column1: (Vasily connected the communication and also looked around.)
column2: (Vasily menyambungkan komunikasi dan ikut menyapu pandangan ke sekeliling.)

column1: Everyone, Mokosh's underground sewer system is very complex, with many pipes and natural tunnels connecting to the outside. The conditions of these passages are harsh, and humans cannot pass through, but they are not an obstacle for Dolls.
column2: Semuanya, sistem saluran bawah tanah Mokosh sangat rumit, dengan banyak pipa dan terowongan alami yang tersambung ke luar. Kondisi lorong-lorong itu keras dan manusia tidak bisa melewatinya, tapi itu bukan halangan bagi Doll.

column1: You can use these waterways to escape, meet up with the Commander, and continue fighting in the future.
column2: Kalian bisa memakai saluran air itu untuk meloloskan diri, bergabung kembali dengan Komandan, dan melanjutkan pertempuran di kemudian hari.

column1: (Vasily thought his words were sincere, but the communication channel was just silent.)
column2: (Vasily merasa ucapannya tulus, tapi kanal komunikasi justru hening.)

column1: (After a long while, the voices of the Dolls came through, accompanied by the 'bang bang' sound of crossfire.)
column2: (Setelah cukup lama, suara para Doll terdengar, diiringi bunyi 'dor dor' baku tembak.)

column1: Hey, Big Sis, Zhaohui, Faye, do you think our Monsoon will retreat?
column2: Hei, Kak, Zhaohui, Faye, menurut kalian Monsoon kita akan mundur?

column1: Of course not, cut the crap.
column2: Jelas tidak, sudah jangan ngomong yang aneh-aneh.

column1: As said before, Monsoon Squad will not leave.
column2: Seperti yang sudah dikatakan, Monsoon Squad tidak akan pergi.

column1: Mr. Vasily, you have your responsibilities, and Monsoon also has Monsoon's duties.
column2: Pak Vasily, Anda punya tanggung jawab Anda, dan Monsoon juga punya tugas Monsoon.

column1: Yes, the Monsoon Squad won't easily abandon their comrades.
column2: Ya, Monsoon Squad tidak akan gampang meninggalkan rekan-rekannya.

column1: Team 2 is the same.
column2: Tim 2 juga sama.

column1: Guarding this place is the Commander's order. Even if the Commander isn't here, we will hold on until the last moment.
column2: Menjaga tempat ini adalah perintah Komandan. Sekalipun Komandan tidak ada di sini, kami akan bertahan sampai detik terakhir.

column1: (In the channel, the sound of guns and artillery continued non-stop. The Dolls, however, spoke no more, seemingly using silence as proof of their will.)
column2: (Di kanal itu, suara senapan dan artileri terus berlanjut tanpa henti. Para Doll justru tak bicara lagi, seolah menjadikan keheningan sebagai bukti tekad mereka.)

column1: (Silent for a long time, Vasily tightly clenched his fists.)
column2: (Setelah lama terdiam, Vasily mengepalkan tinjunya erat-erat.)

column1: Alright, I thank everyone on behalf of Mokosh!
column2: Baiklah, saya berterima kasih pada kalian semua atas nama Mokosh!

column1: After this battle is over, if we still have the chance to meet alive, I will definitely throw a celebration banquet and invite you and the Commander for a drink!
column2: Setelah pertempuran ini usai, kalau kita masih berkesempatan bertemu hidup-hidup, saya pasti akan menggelar pesta perayaan dan mengundang kalian serta Komandan untuk minum-minum!

column1: Ptoey, ptoey, ptoey! You're not allowed to say such unlucky things!
column2: Amit-amit, amit-amit, amit-amit! Anda tidak boleh bicara yang membawa sial begitu!

column1: Mr. Vasily, you are an important ally to the Commander, and an indispensable leader to Mokosh.
column2: Pak Vasily, Anda sekutu penting bagi Komandan, dan pemimpin yang tak tergantikan bagi Mokosh.

column1: Please be sure to take care of yourself. Only if you survive will Mokosh have a chance to win the future.
column2: Tolong jaga diri Anda baik-baik. Hanya kalau Anda selamat, Mokosh punya peluang merebut masa depan.

column1: I agree! Commander Vasily, Mokosh cannot do without you.
column2: Saya setuju! Komandan Vasily, Mokosh tidak bisa tanpa Anda.

column1: So, I will stay too! With me here, at least I can help you handle material coordination and various battle report readings!
column2: Jadi saya juga akan tinggal! Selama ada saya, setidaknya saya bisa membantu Anda mengurus koordinasi material dan membaca berbagai laporan tempur!

column1: ...Alright. I will remember everyone's requests.
column2: ...Baiklah. Saya akan mengingat permintaan kalian semua.

column1: Then, I will command the final battle from here. I leave the operations outside to you all!
column2: Kalau begitu, saya akan memimpin pertempuran terakhir dari sini. Operasi di luar saya serahkan pada kalian semua!

column1: Everyone, make good use of the tunnels... prepare a retreat route for the humans. Until the last moment arrives, we should not give up hope.
column2: Semuanya, manfaatkan terowongan itu baik-baik... siapkan jalur mundur untuk manusia. Sampai detik terakhir tiba, kita tidak boleh melepas harapan.
